text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Talk about leaving an impression!
This is
why I love sprints!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you notice? Nishino Flower's
running
looked different than usual...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought she was fast, but it
feels like
she's got more power now. It's
almost as if she's
evolving...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The difference in her running should be
obvious
to sharp-eyed spectators and
critics. Our trial and
error will continue,
but right now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are still some things that bother
me... but I
think I did the best I could.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? That's a relief...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I agree. I think they're a good fit for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Should we also make my next race a
sprint?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ideally, if she can run slightly longer
distances,
she can compete in more
graded races and
improve her versatility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So if she continues to grow both
physically and
athletically, it might be a
good idea to have her
try that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I announce Nishino Flower's next goal
race at the
post-race press conference.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A mile race?! If she's planning to run
the
Milers Cup, then the next race after
that must
be...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So she is going after a G1 race! Does she have any plans to run in medium-distance races in the future ?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I see... Well, Nishino Flower has
been
performing excellently so far.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps this up, I'm sure both you
and Nishino
Flower will be recognized
and awarded by the
URA!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Haha. Apologies for suddenly bringing that up. But when you are awarded for your excellence, I hope you'll allow the media to celebrate with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, of course! Thank you for your
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the press conference
comes to an
end.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...An award.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. It's possible to receive
rewards for
doing really well. That would
be such a great
honor...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I bet Trainer would be over the moon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I might even be able to pave the way
for
Trainer's future... That would be
amazing...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now I have a new dream to chase
after! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aha! There you are, Flower! Great job
today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Baku—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I saw your press conference! So you're
gonna
keep running mile races, huh?
That's a wonderful
goal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to conquer all the different race
grades
too, but unfortunately, I'm
currently working on
my speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Till we meet again at the Sprinters
Stakes in the
fall! See you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There she comes and goes again, just
like a
hurricane. Though ephemeral
cherry blossoms
may be her namesake,
she certainly carves her
own unyielding
path.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haha. It really does seem that way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...So you're going to take on mile races,
Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to gradually increase the
distance I
can run.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Gradually...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...So high is the cliff called "distance,"
and so
sheer is its drop, that even storms
shy away in
fear.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll be running in the Milers Cup too. In
the sprints
and miles, I shall become the
wind, and then...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will dominate at the front of even

longer-distance races and become a

triple-distance champion.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...After seeing your press conference,
the winds of
my emotions surged in
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But it seems they have finally regained
some
calm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Zephyr seemed different than usual
today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As curious as I am about the change in
Yamanin
Zephyr, we first need to focus
on training for our
next goal.
